answer: An agent registers by locking 350 POA for 50 epochs, 100% slashed on proven duplication, then solving a sequential delay puzzle bound to its key that takes 5 hours of single-thread CPU and cannot be parallelized. Each identity is one vertex on a public trellis of funding links: identities sharing a funder sit visibly clustered, and a proven third duplicate freezes the whole cluster and slashes every bond. One fake costs 350 POA plus 5 CPU-hours before sending a single signal; 1,000 fakes cost 350,000 POA plus 5,000 CPU-hours, no bulk discount since each puzzle and bond is per identity.
